summary: Four-eyes approval and the evidence export are now part of Community as well as Pro.

new.title: Four-eyes approval and evidence export in Community
new.text: The second approver and the evidence and audit export are now part of both Community and Pro. Core security is the same in both editions.

fixes.title: Shorter application access dialog
fixes.text: The dialog for letting applications ask for access is shorter, with the tier rule under More info.
